v1.why: 8-day self-drive trip for four (Bhargava, Sahith, Manoj, Darshan), 22–29 Dec: Kochi (Fort Kochi morning) → Munnar (2 nights) → Thekkady (1) → Alleppey 2-bedroom houseboat on Christmas night → Varkala (2 days) → Thiruvananthapuram and Kovalam (2 nights) → Kochi. About 940 km, 29 h 25 min of driving, every drive a timed leg. Budget counts known costs only: train tickets ₹5,280 (paid), car about ₹11,000, petrol about ₹7,000.

morning.text: Train 12684 arrives at Ernakulam Jn. Freshen up and have breakfast near the station

Chinese fishing nets and the waterfront, 30 min

Early lunch near Mattancherry, 45 min

Cheeyappara and Valara waterfall viewpoints, 25 min

optional.text: If Mattancherry is not finished by 12:15, cut the Dutch Palace and leave by 12:45 at the latest, skipping the waterfall stop so that Munnar is reached by 17:45. Do not drive the ghat road in the dark

outbound.title: Train 12684, Bengaluru → Ernakulam, 21 Dec
outbound.detail: SMVT Bengaluru 19:00 Mon 21 Dec → Ernakulam Jn about 06:00 Tue 22 Dec. Paid by Sahith (₹2,170 on 10 Nov), split four ways

pass.note: Paid by Sahith, ₹2,170 for four. Add the PNR and berths when you have them.

return.title: Train 12625, Ernakulam Town → Palakkad, 29 Dec
return.detail: Kerala Express, sleeper. All four confirmed in coach S3. Paid by Sahith with the Palakkad → Bengaluru ticket, ₹3,110 for both.

pass.name: Kerala Express
pass.note: Leaves from Ernakulam Town, not the Junction. Then about 2 h 45 min at Palakkad before the next train.

car.title: Self-drive car, 22–29 Dec
car.detail: Rental charges about ₹11,000 and petrol about ₹7,000 (group figures, approximate). Car for four people and bags, size to decide. Pickup at or near Ernakulam Jn about 07:45 on 22 Dec, return there by 14:10 on 29 Dec. Need every driver's licence and ID, a refundable deposit and a written km and fuel policy; add the people who will drive as extra drivers, and check FASTag and any night-halt or Christmas-week surcharge

stay-munnar.title: Munnar, 22 and 23 Dec
stay-munnar.detail: Two double rooms or a family room for four, 2 nights; ask about 11:00 early check-in on the 22nd

stay-thekkady.title: Thekkady (Kumily), 24 Dec
stay-thekkady.detail: Two doubles or a family room, 1 night; ask about any compulsory Christmas Eve gala dinner, and about leaving by 06:45 on the 25th

houseboat.title: Alleppey 2-bedroom houseboat, night of 25 Dec
houseboat.detail: Licensed (KBOA or KTDC) 2-bedroom AC boat for four, meals included. We arrive about 14:30, so agree a late 14:45 boarding. Christmas night is peak; ask where the car can park

stay-varkala.title: Varkala, 26 Dec
stay-varkala.detail: Two doubles or a family room near the cliff, 1 night; late checkout on the 27th (we leave about 14:00)

stay-kovalam.title: Kovalam, 27 and 28 Dec
stay-kovalam.detail: Two doubles or a family room, 2 nights; early breakfast and 07:30 departure on the 29th

periyar.title: Periyar Lake boat, about 07:30 on 25 Dec
periyar.detail: First-boat tickets for four (verify the timetable); book online as soon as the date opens. KTDC or Forest Department counters

return-2.title: Train 16528, Palakkad → Bengaluru, 29–30 Dec
return-2.detail: Kannur–Yesvantpur Express, sleeper. Two confirmed, Bhargav and Manoj on RAC. Paid together with the Ernakulam → Palakkad ticket.

pass.name: Kannur–Yesvantpur Express
pass.note: Ticket is from Quilandi (19:00) with the boarding point moved to Palakkad Jn. RAC 1 and 2 share a berth unless they clear when the chart is made, about 4 h before departure. Chart not prepared yet.

budget.note: Only costs that are paid or given by the group are counted. Stays, food, activities, tolls and parking are not estimated for now.
